newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end Tokyo higher on continued cash buying.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end Tokyo higher on continued cash buying.

text.p: * Key March JGBs ended Wednesday higher as cash bond buying continued from Tuesday. The contract jumped, especially after its break above a resistance level of 124.67 in late trade.
* A 10-year JGB auction to be held on Thursday may not hurt the market although record low 2.7 percent coupon is likely.
